entries.words: I keep out of the business of the orders and companies.

The Many-Root Conclave is the order of stewards who care for the Hist. The Conclave sends tree-minders to the villages. A minder tends one tree and reads its signs. Each minder sees that the tree is asked for its consent. A minder feels when the eggs are in trouble.

The Reed-Sail Compact is the guild of boat crews. It fixes each crew's share of a route and holds its monopoly by stoppage. When a council tried to license the boats that carry cargo ashore from anchored ships, the crews stopped work for two weeks.

The Blackrose Chainbreakers audit the Owing and burn false debts. They hold that freeing debtors and carrying the dead home are one work, because a debtor who dies far from the Hist may never get home.
